I am writing in response to the deduction notice received for the property at 5BHK kasol. I dispute several of the proposed deductions.

The deduction for repainting all walls is disputed as the lease does not require this, and no evidence of damage beyond normal wear and tear has been provided. The deduction for deep cleaning is disputed because the lease only requires the property to be left 'reasonably clean,' and no specific areas of unreasonable cleanliness have been detailed. The deduction for a missing access card is disputed as the lease does not address access cards, and no evidence of its issuance or absence has been provided. While the lease assigns responsibility for electricity, the deduction for an outstanding electricity bill is disputed as no evidence, such as a copy of the bill, has been provided to substantiate the amount.

The total amount being disputed is ₹16,850.

I request a revised refund breakdown or the full disputed amount of ₹16,850 to be returned within 7 days. If I do not receive a response, I will follow up in writing.
